body:
## Run 3 preflight NO-GO; run paused at the prerequisite gate

Run rn_01m7k67v5dktx342mvntz47xh5 (saved revision 2). Both row-1 tickets were claimed once, finished in under 2 minutes each, and failed non-retryable. No native, model, compiler or runtime launches; no installs or configuration changes. Zero accepted.

- **DM-613 (S1)** at_01m7k6dxhc0v7p88wyg7m9z7aq, report `docs/reports/desktop-controls-DM-613-source.json` on `desktop-rn3-dm613-s1` @ 510d4595509a06df70522939b0f63834e3fc5040. `%LOCALAPPDATA%\omp\omp.exe` changed since run 2 (now SHA256 6dbb8ac3…, 252504064 bytes; prior 753c705d…, 18.20.3). DM still resolves the image by path only, without pinning a hash or version. The Skitarii extension registers no `tool_call` handler. No single supported pre-execution seam covers the normal, nested/eval, MCP and subagent routes.
- **DM-614 (V0)** at_01m7k6dzv32w4cy2a8hgzd8x9p, report `docs/reports/desktop-controls-DM-614-source.json` on `desktop-rn3-dm614-v0` @ 21596135f1866d99aecd3f0fc2a2ab48e1cdd8ad. Windows 10.0.26200.9711 x64 meets the build-22000 minimum. `Windows Kits` and `Microsoft SDKs` are now **absent**, where run 2 saw labels for 10.0.26100.0 and NETFXSDK 4.8.1, so `UserConsentVerifierInterop.h` is unavailable. There is no repo-owned bounded compile/run containment, and Hello availability is UNKNOWN.
- **Plan-wide blocker:** the epic branch `agent-desktop-controls`, research tip 4f99122b12f852d53308e483c322d6dbeb7307e2 and every earlier evidence commit (9b16b5a9, 46b710a, 8a8f991, 647f689, caef247) are missing from this clone (now under OneDrive), from origin and from this disk. DM-541 (C1) and most downstream tickets curate from 4f99122, so they cannot run as written even after S1 and V0 pass.

The run is paused and no retry was spent. Resuming needs a person to decide: restore or push the research branch, or redraft the plan; supply a pinned managed OMP image and a supported approval seam; and install a Windows SDK or approve a bounded build boundary. Re-claiming the same tickets unchanged would reproduce the NO-GO.
